name: Control
short: One panel for every cog's settings and commands, owner tools, and a slash /help.
description: Adds a single /control panel where server admins can change the settings of every cog that supports it and turn commands on or off per server, plus owner tools (load/unload/reload cogs, force-update a repo, sync slash commands, last error) and a /help menu that lists every loaded cog's slash commands by category.
author: itsneufox
install_msg: Control loaded! Open the panel with `[p]control`, or use `/help` to browse slash commands. For the slash versions, run `[p]slash enablecog control` and then `[p]slash sync`. The bot owner also gets an Owner tools page in the panel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any data.
